purpose: Test FUNCTION_TO_CONCEPT_SYNTHESIS_EXTENSION against an existing mature P02 object without changing Current authority.

functions.failure: reads/behaves as full sitting or cannot support lean relation

functions.failure: encroaches on required passage or creates protrusion conflict

allow inspection and replacement of contact, buffer and fastening elements
functions.failure: wear item cannot be inspected/replaced without destructive work

recovery element cannot consume required passage
geometry/height/depth must preserve standing half-lean semantics

solution_principles.principle: local broadened cap/sleeve over host rail member
reversible clamp to existing rail members
suspended/tension transfer between verified host points

compatibility.condition: existing rail/load path and clamp behavior verified

suspended support controls movement and edge interaction
requires prototype for deflection/contact + structural clamp verification

tension system remains shallow, stable and non-entrapment
host rail geometry allows sleeve and verified load transfer
host-rail sleeve principle and structurally independent floor support are mutually exclusive support architectures
local cap/sleeve and suspended tension architecture are different mutually exclusive load-transfer families

reject if route clearance/foundation authority fails

matched_embodiment_requirement.rule: All three families shown at the same schematic fidelity; no polished Current rendering is used as the comparison advantage.

rationale: C-A aligns with the Current causal family and the existing Current already contains reversible clamp, drainage/cleaning, replaceability and passage-first logic.
C-B demonstrates that an independent-load-path concept is materially different, but introduces route-footprint/foundation/permission burdens that remain unverified.
C-C demonstrates a distinct compliant/tension mechanism but introduces additional dynamic/contact/structural uncertainty.
Retrospective replay is not independent evidence and therefore cannot reselect or promote P02.

technical_handoffs.question: existing rail/base load capacity and local attachment/tension effects
standing half-lean human fit, protrusion/contact/climb/edge behavior

method_findings: Function decomposition exposed that attachment and load transfer cannot be independent matrix rows.
Compatibility filtering prevented a naive Cartesian product from being described as viable concepts.
Three causal concept families remained after bundling/deduplication.
The replay explains Current P02 as one host-dependent rigid-clamp architecture while preserving alternatives and field HOLDs.
The extension did not create structural, accessibility or field PASS.
